desc:
• PROTEIN BARS: Every delicious 90-calorie strawberries and cream flavored protein bar has 10g of protein; A good source of protein

  • KETO FRIENDLY: 1g sugar and 2g net carbs per serving; 2g net carbs = 11g total carbs - 5g fiber - 4g sugar alcohol; Always consult your physician before starting an eating plan that involves regular consumption of high fat foods

  • A GOOD SOURCE OF FIBER: Each serving has 5g fiber (total fat 2g, sat. fat 1.5g)

  • SNACK BARS: Feel like one smart cookie when you say 'yes' to your sweet tooth; An ideal office or lunch box snack, part of breakfast, or on the go treat

  • CONTAINS: One 4.8 oz box of Protein One 90 Calorie Strawberries and Cream Protein Bars; 5 bars
features:
Features

90 Calories Per Bar
A guilt-free, portion-controlled snack option.

10 g Protein + 5 g Fiber
Supports energy levels and satiety to help manage hunger.

Low Sugar & Keto-Friendly
Contains only 1 g sugar and 2 g net carbs—perfect for low-carb lifestyles.

Strawberries & Cream Flavor
A smooth and fruity flavor that blends sweet strawberry notes with creamy undertones.

Individually Wrapped Bars
Easy to carry for travel, lunchboxes, or workday snacking. 

Benefits

Smart Snacking Option
Helps curb cravings with high protein and fiber while staying low in calories.

Supports Weight Management
Ideal for calorie-controlled and sugar-conscious eating plans.

Convenient and Ready-to-Eat
No prep needed—just grab and go when hunger hits.

Versatile Usage
Great for breakfast on the run, post-workout recovery, or a healthy dessert alternative.
ingredients: Soy Protein Isolate, Chicory Root Extract, Whey Protein Isolate, Maltitol Syrup, Vegetable Glycerin, Isomalt, Palm Kernel Oil, Soy Lecithin, Calcium Caseinate, Strawberry Powder, Collagen, Salt, Stevia Extract, Malic Acid, Citric Acid, Natural Flavor, Color (Red 40, Yellow 6, Blue 1), Canola Oil.
